faq.q: What is the origin of Zuhair?
faq.a: Zuhair is associated with Arabic. Zuhair is Arabic زُهَيْر (Zuhayr), a diminutive associated with the sense 'blossom, small flower'.
Yes — the underlying form زُهَيْر is Arabic.
Zuhair can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
